# PPC Growth Expert

> Independent Amazon PPC Consultancy & Performance Growth Agency founded by Anmol Pokhriyal. Helping e-commerce brands in India, US, UK, and global marketplaces scale Amazon ad revenue, reduce ACoS, maximize ROAS, and optimize unit economics through data-driven PPC strategies.

## Core Services
- [Amazon PPC Management Services](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-ppc-management): Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaign architecture and continuous bidding optimization.
- [Amazon Listing Optimization](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-listing-optimization): Conversion rate (CVR) optimization, SEO copywriting, and keyword indexation.
- [Amazon A+ Content & Image Design](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-image-aplus): Premium visual storytelling, infographics, and Enhanced Brand Content (EBC).
- [Amazon Keyword Research](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-keyword-research): High-intent search term harvesting, reverse ASIN lookup, and keyword isolation.
- [Amazon Product Research](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-product-research): Niche profitability analysis, competitor auditing, and market opportunity validation.
- [Amazon Review Growth Support](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/services.html#service-review-growth): Compliant Request-a-Review automation and Vine enrollment strategy.

## Free Calculators & Tools
- [Amazon ACoS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-acos-calculator.html): Calculate Advertising Cost of Sales and margin safety thresholds.
- [Amazon ROAS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-roas-calculator.html): Calculate Return on Ad Spend and campaign revenue multiplier.
- [Amazon PPC Conversion Rate Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-ppc-conversion-rate-calculator.html): Measure order conversion percentage from ad traffic.
- [Amazon CPC Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-cpc-calculator.html): Calculate cost-per-click across keywords and ad groups.
- [Amazon CTR Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-ctr-calculator.html): Evaluate ad creative and placement click-through rate.
- [Amazon TACoS Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-tacos-calculator.html): Compare total advertising cost against total brand revenue.
- [Amazon India Profit Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-profit-calculator.html): Calculate net profit payout, referral fees, closing fees, and 18% GST impact for FBA & MFN in India.
- [Amazon FBA Fee Calculator India](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-fba-fee-calculator.html): Calculate pick & pack, weight handling, and storage fee breakdowns.
- [Amazon FBA Storage Fee Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-fba-storage-fee-calculator.html): Estimate monthly inventory storage costs based on dimensions and sell-through velocity.
- [Amazon Advertising ROI Calculator](https://ppcgrowthexpert.com/amazon-advertising-roi-calculator.html): Calculate net ROI after deducting ad spend, COGS, and marketplace fees.
